name: verify_identity
description: Check who is on the line against the record. Required before discussing any health information. Pass what the person said: their own name (caller_name), whether they are the patient ('self') or someone on the patient's behalf ('caregiver', 'other'), and the PATIENT's full name and date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD). When the patient is speaking, caller_name and patient_name are the same.

caller_name.description: The name of the person on the line, as they said it

relationship.description: self if the patient is speaking, caregiver if they help with the patient's care, other otherwise

patient_name.description: The patient's full name, as the caller said it

patient_date_of_birth.description: The patient's date of birth as the caller said it, written YYYY-MM-DD

name: escalate
description: Route a concern to the clinical team. emergency_now: the person must call 911 (or 988) now. same_day_clinician: a nurse must call back today. routine_followup: note for the next routine review.

red_flag.description: the symptom or issue, in a few words

name: flag_med_issue
description: Record a discrepancy between the discharge medication list and what the patient is actually taking, for pharmacist review.

issue_type.description: omission, duplicate, stopped_still_taking, dose_mismatch or not_filled

detail.description: What the patient said, in one sentence

name: handoff_to_human
description: Transfer the call to a nurse now. Ends your part of the call.

name: record_opt_out
description: Record that the person asked not to receive these calls.

name: leave_voicemail
description: Leave a voicemail message. Ends the call.
